zh: 一个子数组按最大连续相同值段分成长度 L₁..L_m 的段，选法数是各段长度之积；但如果所有段长度都是 1（本身已压缩），按题意记 0 而不是 1。
先把所有子数组都按“段长度乘积”求和，再减去已压缩的子数组个数。落在一个段内部的子数组总贡献是 L(L+1)(L+2)/6；跨段的子数组贡献为首段后缀长度 × 中间各段长度 × 末段前缀长度。
把数组分段；扫描每段 L：令 T=L(L+1)/2，total += L(L+1)(L+2)/6 + T·acc，然后 acc = acc·L + T（acc 是之前每段的 T 乘以其后各完整段长度之和）；再统计相邻元素都不同的极大连续块，每块长 G 减去 G(G+1)/2；全程对 1,000,000,007 取模，注意中间乘积别溢出。
en: A subarray splits into maximal runs of equal values with lengths L₁..L_m, and the number of choices is the product of the run lengths; but if every run has length 1 (the subarray is already compressed), the statement counts it as 0, not 1.

First sum the product of run lengths over all subarrays, then subtract the number of already compressed subarrays. Subarrays inside a single run contribute L(L+1)(L+2)/6 in total; a subarray spanning several runs contributes (suffix length in the first run) × (lengths of the full middle runs) × (prefix length in the last run).

Split the array into runs; for each run L let T = L(L+1)/2, add L(L+1)(L+2)/6 + T·acc to total, then set acc = acc·L + T (acc is the sum over earlier runs of their T times the lengths of the full runs after them); then for each maximal block with no equal neighbors, of length G, subtract G(G+1)/2; reduce modulo 1,000,000,007 throughout and keep intermediate products from overflowing.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Represent the array by the lengths L of its maximal runs of equal values. All subarrays within a single run contribute L(L+1)(L+2)/6 in total. A subarray spanning runs contributes the product of the suffix length in its first run, the prefix length in its last run, and the lengths of the complete runs in between; maintaining a weighted sum over earlier endpoints allows an O(1) update. Finally subtract all subarrays with no equal adjacent elements, since they are already compressed and contribute 0.

## Correctness

If a subarray splits into maximal runs of equal values with lengths L_i, the standard compressed result keeps one original index from each run, independently, so the number of choices is ∏L_i; if every L_i=1, the statement's example says an already compressed subarray counts as 0. For intervals inside a single run, summing over their lengths gives L(L+1)(L+2)/6. For intervals with first run i and last run j (i<j), the first run can contribute a suffix of length x=1..L_i and the last run a prefix of length y=1..L_j, with the middle runs complete; the sum factors as T(L_i)T(L_j)∏(middle L_k), where T(L)=L(L+1)/2; maintaining a weighted prefix sum computes all j online. The already compressed subarrays are exactly the intervals of the original sequence with no equal adjacent pair; a maximal such block of length G contains G(G+1)/2 of them, and each one is subtracted once since it contributed 1. Reducing modulo the modulus throughout gives the required sum.

## Complexity

Each test case takes O(n) time and O(n) extra space (reading the input and splitting it into runs).
